tweet.text:
The lineup. Five full production stacks, not just weights:

FP8 baseline on vllm, 2x3090 NVFP4 W4A16 on vllm, 2x3090 AWQ INT4 on vllm, 2x3090 GGUF Q4_K_M on llama.cpp, 2x3090 NInfer on a single 3090

Each one ran reasoning off, low, medium and xhigh. Per mode: 150 agentic and coding scenarios (CLI work, bug hunting, tool calls, structured output) plus 90 reasoning tasks (HumanEval+, LiveCodeBench v6, GSM-Symbolic).

The model thinks as long as it wants and I log every reasoning token of every call. 40 arms total. That is why it took two and a half days.
